title: ghd straightener three-beep fault
fullDescription:
ghd Platinum+, Gold and Max emit three beeps and refuse to heat when the start-up self-test detects a sensor mismatch. Most often caused by storing the iron while still warm in a heatproof bag — moisture condensed on the PCB.

Leave unplugged 24 hours, then retry.

fixSteps.title: Dry out
fixSteps.instruction: Leave unplugged in dry room for 24h.

fixSteps.title: Power test
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in — listen for single startup beep.

fixSteps.title: Service if persists
fixSteps.instruction: Send to ghd Repair — sensor swap.

faq.a: Yes — flat-fee around USD 60-80, includes 12-month warranty.

title: ghd Platinum+ LED flashing
shortDescription: Predictive technology unable to read plates.
fullDescription:
Platinum+ uses Predictive Technology — six sensors per plate sample at 250 Hz. A flashing LED means one sensor is offline. Iron will heat at reduced safety power but won't reach 185°C target.

Use a Reset cable from ghd Service.

fixSteps.title: Compare both plates
fixSteps.instruction: Touch metal probe to each plate after 1 min — should both feel hot.

title: ghd Gold/IV completely dead
fullDescription:
Older ghd irons (IV, Gold) have a known on/off membrane switch failure. The membrane fatigues at the dome and stops making contact. Replacement membrane kits are sold but require disassembly.

Verify with a different outlet first.

fixSteps.title: Try another outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Verify outlet works with another device.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cord
fixSteps.instruction: Flex cord at strain relief; intermittent power = damaged cord.

fixSteps.title: Replace membrane
fixSteps.instruction: Open shell, swap on/off membrane PCB.

whenToCallPro: If you do not own a Torx security set.
videoSearchQuery: ghd Gold won't turn on membrane switch

faq.a: Yes if you buy genuine ghd parts; cheap clones drift in temp.

title: ghd entering sleep mode early
shortDescription: Auto sleep at 30 min — sometimes triggers in 5.
fullDescription:
ghd irons auto-sleep at 30 minutes idle. Premature sleep happens when the motion sensor (in newer models) is misreading, or when the power LED brightness sensor sees darkness and assumes dropped.

Update by toggling on/off three times rapidly to clear cached calibration.

fixSteps.title: Use on flat surface
fixSteps.instruction: Test on flat table — confirm 30 minute hold.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: If still sleeping early, accelerometer is loose.

faq.a: No — it's a non-overridable safety feature.

title: ghd one plate cold
fullDescription:
Each ghd plate has its own ceramic heater. If only one plate heats, the cold-plate heater is open circuit (most common) or the connector to the heater unseated.

Must be replaced — heaters are bonded into the plate.

fixSteps.title: Confirm with probe
fixSteps.instruction: After 1 min on, both plates should feel hot.

fixSteps.title: Send for repair
fixSteps.instruction: ghd Service plate swap is far cheaper than DIY.

faq.a: ghd Service repair often half the price of new iron.

title: ghd Helios dryer fan slow
fullDescription:
Helios uses an Aeroprecis brushless motor. A clogged rear filter starves the motor and the controller throttles to keep current safe. Cleaning the filter restores full speed.

If airflow remains weak after cleaning, the controller has logged a fault that needs ghd service.
whenToCallPro: If reduced airflow persists with clean filter.

faq.a: Yes — rinse with water, no soap.

title: ghd Curve curling iron clamp stuck
fullDescription:
ghd Curve series uses a torsion spring at the pivot. Hair-product residue thickens in the pivot bushing and locks the spring after a few months without cleaning.

Wipe pivot with isopropyl while warm — never spray cleaner directly.

fixSteps.title: Warm to operating temp
fixSteps.instruction: Switch on for 1 minute then unplug.

fixSteps.title: Clean pivot
fixSteps.instruction: Apply isopropyl with cotton swab while working clamp.

fixSteps.title: High-temp lube
fixSteps.instruction: Tiny dab silicone grease 200°C-rated at pivot only.

whenToCallPro: If spring snapped (you'll see clamp dangling).

title: Platinum+ star LED flashing
fullDescription:
On Platinum+, the star icon flashes during heat-up and goes solid when ready (~20 seconds). Permanent flashing means the iron never reaches setpoint — usually due to a low-voltage outlet (<210V on 230V model) or a partial heater failure.

Measure outlet voltage and try another circuit.
whenToCallPro: If voltage is normal and star still flashes.

faq.a: ghd is dual-voltage — but cheap travel adapters drop voltage.

title: ghd Unplugged battery low
shortDescription: Single charge not lasting full styling session.
fullDescription:
Unplugged uses a removable battery pack rated for 20 minutes. After ~300 cycles capacity drops below 50%. ghd sells replacement packs; the pack also has an internal fault flag that engages with deep discharge.

Reset by removing pack 1 minute then replacing.
symptoms: Red battery LED on full charge
whenToCallPro: Not needed — DIY swap is trivial.

faq.a: Yes — pack is under 100Wh, allowed in carry-on.

title: ghd Flight not heating abroad
shortDescription: Travel iron stuck on wrong voltage.
fullDescription:
ghd Flight is dual-voltage 110/240V auto-sensing. If the outlet voltage drops during heat-up (cheap adapter), the controller can latch in low-power mode for the session. Power cycle for 30 seconds to re-sense.

Use only ungrounded plug adapters with full mains current rating.

fixSteps.title: Try outlet without adapter
fixSteps.instruction: If region uses Type C (Europe) and you have Type C plug, skip adapter.

whenToCallPro: If iron only ever heats slowly, even on home outlet.

faq.a: No — Flight needs mains, not USB.
